issues: The chapter lacked the standard onboarding block.

Improved the reader's conceptual foothold before the formal model.

repair.summary: The scale-transition issue was repaired during the editorial pass.
actions_taken: Clarified the move from leaf optics to canopy optics.
Improved the interpretive lead-in to canopy geometry and hotspot effects.

design_review.summary: The chapter's canopy-scale visuals and geometry now sit on stronger explanatory support.
